jp: 授業[じゅぎょう]{が|ga-sub-clause}始[はじ]まる前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}、教科書[きょうかしょ]{を|o-object}読[よ]んでおきます。
en: I read the textbook before the class starts.
why: The reading comes first, so the earlier action is marked with 前に after the dictionary form.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}質問[しつもん]{を|o-object}した後[あと]{で/に|maeni-atode}、答[こた]え{を|o-object}ノート{に|ni-destination}書[か]きました。
en: After asking the teacher a question, I wrote the answer in my notebook.
why: The writing came once the question was finished, so the past form takes 後で.

jp: テスト{が|ga-sub-clause}終[お]わった後[あと]{で/に|maeni-atode}、友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}ご飯[はん]{を|o-object}食[た]べ{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きました。
en: After the test was over, I went to eat with my friends.
why: The meal followed the end of the test, so the past form takes 後で.

jp: 会社[かいしゃ]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]く前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}、駅[えき]{で|de-place}新聞[しんぶん]{を|o-object}買[か]います。
en: I buy a newspaper at the station before I go to the office.
why: Buying the paper comes first, so 行く takes 前に.

jp: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}アルバイト{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}、図書館[としょかん]{で|de-place}勉強[べんきょう]します。
en: Today I'll study at the library before my part-time job.
why: の前に marks the earlier activity relative to the noun event, 'the part-time job'.

jp: 資料[しりょう]{を|o-object}送[おく]る前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}、先生[せんせい]{に|ni-recipient}見[み]せてください。
en: Please show it to the teacher before you send the materials.
why: Showing the teacher comes first, so 送る takes 前に.
